lines.text: What are you saying? Please come closer.
lines.translatedText: What are you saying? Please come closer.

lines.text: I can see you trying to talk, but you are too far away.
lines.translatedText: I can see you trying to talk, but you are too far away.

lines.text: A little closer, please. Your voice is not reaching me from there.
lines.translatedText: A little closer, please. Your voice is not reaching me from there.
